dashRole.description: Resolved dashboard persona (SESSION_ROLE code: EQUIP_MGR | REQUESTOR | INSPECTION | TIMEKEEPER | TIME_APPROVER | FINANCE_USER). Set by dashboardInitChain from $application.functions.resolveDashboardRole(). Drives which KPI tiles and which table this page renders.

dashSubtitle.defaultValue: Real-time equipment lifecycle metrics and operational status.

tableViewAllNav.description: Nav-list id the table's 'View All' button routes to. Persona-specific; resolved through NAV_ID_TO_ROUTE by gotoNavTargetChain.

tableRowNav.description: Row-click routing key for navigateDashboardRowChain: dashboardRoleConfig's table.rowNav when set (INSPECTION), else table.shape. Decides WHICH drill-down a dashboard row opens, so each persona lands on the detail page matching its own table instead of everyone getting equipment-request-detail. Defaults to myRequests — the request-detail route — which is correct for the requestor persona the dashboard falls back to.

tableColumns.description: oj-table column definitions for the active persona, supplied by dashboardRoleConfig. Bound directly to the table's columns attribute so a persona switch re-renders the grid with no per-role markup.

kpiCards.description: Ordered KPI tile definitions [{key,label,hint,icon,accent,nav,money}] for the active persona. The tile row is rendered with oj-bind-for-each over this, so three-KPI and four-KPI personas need no separate markup.

kpis.description: Computed KPI values keyed by the `key` field of kpiCards. Populated per-persona by dashboardInitChain's COUNTERS.
